entities.name: Kaspar Fürstenau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kaspar Fürstenau was a German flautist and composer. He wrote about sixty compositions for his instrument among rondos, fantasias, suites and concertos. Together with his son Anton Bernhard Fürstenau he traveled extensively around Europe always with acclaimed success.
